summary.intent: Run a code review and cleanup pass on the cipher-box PR #318, fixing reuse, quality, and efficiency issues identified by three parallel review agents.
summary.outcome: Fixed 6 categories of issues across 13 files, reducing net lines by ~140. Both load and sdk-e2e packages compile clean after the refactor.

repo: Account creation logic was duplicated between tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts and tests/load/src/harness/client-pool.ts — extracted to a shared TestAccount interface and createTestAccount/deleteTestAccount helpers.
Load test scenarios each had ~60 lines of duplicated aggregation logic — consolidated into an aggregateAndReport helper.
binState has no public getter on the client; (ctx.client as any).binState casts are acceptable in test code and not worth adding a public API for.
folderTree was previously accessed via (client as any).folderTree — a public client.getFolderTree() method exists and should be used instead.
tests/load/tsconfig.json had a rootDir restriction that prevented importing from sdk-e2e — needed adjustment to allow cross-package test utility sharing.
FolderChild is a union of FilePointer | FolderEntry; fileMetaIpnsName only exists on FilePointer and requires a type cast or type guard.

code.finding: Replaced (client as any).folderTree with client.getFolderTree() throughout.
Added getReadonlySamples() method to MetricsCollector to avoid unnecessary array copies in aggregation.
4 bin error tests each created their own context — refactored to share 1 context. Also removed a redundant double-call in BinNotLoadedError test.
rootDir was too restrictive and blocked cross-package imports from sdk-e2e test utilities.

workflow: Three-agent parallel review (reuse / quality / efficiency) is an effective pattern for comprehensive code review of large diffs.
Skipping false positives explicitly with rationale (e.g., O(n) getter is dead code, Math.max spread on small pools) keeps the fix list actionable without losing context.
TypeScript compilation check after all fixes is a reliable gate before committing — caught tsconfig rootDir issue and unused imports that would have failed CI.

friction: tsconfig rootDir restriction in tests/load blocked cross-package imports and required a config fix before compilation would succeed.
The diff was large enough to require chunked reading before passing to review agents.
fileMetaIpnsName type narrowing on the FolderChild union required an explicit cast in file-workload.ts.
open_items: CI workflow deduplication (reusable workflows) was intentionally skipped — infrastructure churn for 3 rarely-changing workflows.
Raw fetch vs generated API client in vault-lifecycle and share/invite E2E tests was intentionally left — these tests benefit from explicit HTTP visibility.
totalErrors getter is O(n) but is dead code — left as-is since it's never called.
binState has no public getter; if test coverage of internal bin state grows, consider adding a test-only accessor or making it public.
